newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-Smith says Olo Brown uses illegal tactics.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-Smith says Olo Brown uses illegal tactics.

text.p: AUCKLAND, July 23 - Wallaby coach Greg Smith has targeted tighthead prop Olo Brown in his latest attack on the All Blacks ahead of Saturday's tri-nations test in Melbourne, NZPA reports.

Having charged the All Blacks with committing professional fouls during the Bledisloe Cup test in Christchurch two weeks ago and last weekend's match in South Africa, Smith on Wednesday pointed the accusing finger at Olo Brown.
The coach said Brown was not binding properly in the scrum.
"There are still things that are happening in the scrum," Smith told TRN/IRN radio network.
"The binding of the tighthead needs to be looked at. He (Brown) has his hand on the ground and he does that all the time.
"If it is okay for him to do it then everyone should be allowed to do it."
Smith also maintained he wanted English referee Ed Morrison to treat both sides the same.
The Australian coach is upset that Morrison referred to the All Blacks by their first names in the Christchurch test and didn't show the same level of recognition to his players.
"It is an issue I'll be raising with him when I meet him."
